{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
print("Revenue contains commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Show unique revenue values to confirm format
print("Unique revenue values:", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
